title: Exothermic scattering of a metastable excited state as the origin of the LZ 248 keV event: kinematics, spectral shape, companions and the required relic fraction
question: Could down-scattering chi2 N -> chi1 N of a metastable excited state (relic fraction f2, tau >~ t_U) produce a single 248 keV event in 2.84 t yr with nothing else in 5.4-270 keV or 600-1700 phd, for m = 0.3-10 TeV and |delta| = 100-500 keV; can heavy masses or low halo dispersion narrow the line; what f2*sigma, tau and dark-photon parameters are needed; what is the modulation phase; and what Bayes factor does LZ's data give versus the endothermic interpretation?
headline_result: Exact WimPyDD down-scatter spectra put 248 keV above the 98th percentile for every m = 0.3-10 TeV and |delta| = 100-500 keV with 2-7 companions in LZ's empty 125-200 keV bin per event; the exothermic-origin hypothesis gets B <= 2 against background and B(exo/endo) = 0.04-0.67 (0.21 best-vs-best with the June date); heavier masses broaden the window, low dispersion does not help, and a co-moving dark disk is capped at B ~ 2 by its density.
key_numbers: |delta|(E*=248)=349/278/256/251 keV at 0.3/1/4/10 TeV; half-width 138-230 keV; mode<=186, p95<=237 keV; N(125-200)/N(200-270)=5.7/5.4/4.5/2.1 at 278/300/350/500 keV; Z4 2.93-3.07 (P058 reproduced), Z5 2.45-2.73, mu_hat 0.11-0.17; B_exo<=1.96, B_endo(350)=4.2 (10 with date); B(exo/endo)=0.47 (0.21 with date), 0.04-0.67 over priors; sigma_N f2=2.4e-45 cm2 (1 TeV, 300 keV), chi1 events 1.1e-3, m_A'<=5.6 GeV, tau>=1.4 t_U; exothermic date factor 1.02-1.05; dark disk B=65 alone, 2.0 with halo chi2
model_or_mechanism: pseudo-Dirac inelastic DM, exothermic chi2 N -> chi1 N (isoscalar O1, proton-only), exact per-isotope WimPyDD kernel factorisation; five-term observed-energy likelihood over LZ regions; Bayes factors; two-population (f2,delta) plane; SHM/low-dispersion/dark-disk halos
builds_on: LZ paper (Fig. 4, S2/S4, MSSI table); competes with P058; P011, P016, P021, P026, P034, P038, P066
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; WimPyDD 2.0.4; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; multiprocessing; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex (Fig. 4 caption, Fig. S1/S2 captions, MSSI table); PAPER_GUIDE; P058 paper/details/script/cache/CSVs/provenance; papers P011, P016, P021, P026, P034, P038, P066, P002, P007; ledger; lzcommon.py; WimPyDD/package.py
recalled_knowledge: 6 (PDG constants, t_U, exothermic n sigma v ~ v^0, +-1.5 sigma acceptance, Bayes prior conventions [certain]; dark-disk lag/dispersion/density [uncertain])
